design: Reuse H986 native captures at all18 layers for the two semantically eligible families. Discovery: patch donor write bidirectionally at every layer; identity, paired +/- norm-matched Gaussian controls, same-answer discovery donor where available. Select maximum mean signed donor task-margin effect, lowest-layer tie break. Freeze selection before validation. Evaluate all other cohorts at chosen site AND fixed joint-featurizer site MLP12, including failed native gates as diagnostic only.
alignment: Last-token MLP output swap, same final input token required; absolute positions and prompt lengths may differ. This is a whole-write causal assay, not identification of an input subspace or natural latent intervention.
holdouts: No whole-task training holdouts evaluated here. Antonym and country-language are declared non-holdout training candidates; only discovery may supply training targets.
controls: Gaussian seed fixed by pair/source/layer/recipient, identical +/- direction, norm equal to donor delta. Same-answer donor chosen by intersecting intended token groups within discovery, different prompt and pair, first available index; absence disclosed. No per-example correctness filtering.
metrics: Signed task-margin change, output KL(patch||native recipient), KL(native donor||patch) as context-confounded diagnostic. Select on donor task effect only; report corruption specificity separately.
limits: Only4 discovery pairs/family and reused development vocabulary. Whole-write localization does not establish semantic unit or general layer4 relevance.
